# Analytics

Reports over a time window: the summary (with `compare=true` for the previous period), a time series, breakdowns, share of voice across brand and competitor keywords, and reviews. Pass the user's `timezone` when the days matter. Reads are free.

Base URL `https://api.rumoro.dev`, `Authorization: Bearer $RUMORO_API_KEY` on every request, JSON in and out. Each endpoint names its `rumoro` CLI command for when the CLI is installed (rules/cli.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /v1/analytics/summary`: Get summary counts

Returns matched and relevant mentions, unique posts and people, sentiment, buying intent and questions, estimated reach, and the triage status of the matches. Pick the period with `range` (7d, 30d, 90d or 365d up to today) or with `from` and `to`. Days follow `timezone`, UTC by default. `keywordIds` and `platforms` narrow the data, and `compare=true` adds the equally long period just before. Dates are publish dates.

CLI: `rumoro analytics:summary`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `range` | query | `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `365d` |  | A preset period up to today, 30d by default. Ignored when you send from or to. |
| `from` | query | string |  | Start date in `timezone`, as YYYY-MM-DD. That day is included. |
| `to` | query | string |  | End date in `timezone`, as YYYY-MM-DD, included. Defaults to today. |
| `keywordIds` | query | string[] or null |  | Keeps these keyword ids only. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. Leave it out for all keywords. |
| `platforms` | query | list of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Keeps these platforms only. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. Leave it out for all platforms. |
| `compare` | query | boolean |  | true adds the equally long period just before as `previous`. |
| `timezone` | query | string |  | The IANA time zone used to split days, such as America/New_York. Defaults to UTC. The zone's offset at the end of the period is used for the whole period. |

Answers `200` with `window`, `matched`, `relevant`, `posts`, `people`, `sentiment`, `buyIntent`, `questions`, `reach`, `triage`, `previous`: The counts, plus `previous` with compare=true.

### `GET /v1/analytics/series`: Mentions over time

Returns matched, relevant and sentiment counts per day or week over the period. You get one total series, or one per platform or keyword with `by`. Pick the period with `range` (7d, 30d, 90d or 365d up to today) or with `from` and `to`. Days follow `timezone`, UTC by default. `keywordIds` and `platforms` narrow the data, and `compare=true` adds the equally long period just before. Dates are publish dates.

CLI: `rumoro analytics:series`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `range` | query | `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `365d` |  | A preset period up to today, 30d by default. Ignored when you send from or to. |
| `from` | query | string |  | Start date in `timezone`, as YYYY-MM-DD. That day is included. |
| `to` | query | string |  | End date in `timezone`, as YYYY-MM-DD, included. Defaults to today. |
| `keywordIds` | query | string[] or null |  | Keeps these keyword ids only. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. Leave it out for all keywords. |
| `platforms` | query | list of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Keeps these platforms only. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. Leave it out for all platforms. |
| `compare` | query | boolean |  | true adds the equally long period just before as `previous`. |
| `timezone` | query | string |  | The IANA time zone used to split days, such as America/New_York. Defaults to UTC. The zone's offset at the end of the period is used for the whole period. |
| `bucket` | query | `hour`, `day`, `week`, `month` |  | The size of each point. hour for periods up to 14 days, day, week (starting Monday) or month. By default days up to 90 days and weeks beyond. |
| `by` | query | `platform`, `keyword`, `sentiment` |  | Splits the data into a series for each platform, each keyword or each sentiment (positive, neutral, negative, unclassified). By keyword you get the top 20 by matches, with the rest combined as "other". Leave it out for one total series. |

Answers `200` with `window`, `data`, `previous`: The series with zeros for empty points, oldest first.

### `GET /v1/analytics/breakdown`: Get a mention breakdown

`by` sets the rows (platform, keyword, sentiment, intent, status, hour as weekday and hour, or person), and each row has matched, relevant and sentiment counts. Pick the period with `range` (7d, 30d, 90d or 365d up to today) or with `from` and `to`. Days follow `timezone`, UTC by default. `keywordIds` and `platforms` narrow the data, and `compare=true` adds the equally long period just before. Dates are publish dates.

CLI: `rumoro analytics:breakdown`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `range` | query | `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `365d` |  | A preset period up to today, 30d by default. Ignored when you send from or to. |
| `from` | query | string |  | Start date in `timezone`, as YYYY-MM-DD. That day is included. |
| `to` | query | string |  | End date in `timezone`, as YYYY-MM-DD, included. Defaults to today. |
| `keywordIds` | query | string[] or null |  | Keeps these keyword ids only. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. Leave it out for all keywords. |
| `platforms` | query | list of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Keeps these platforms only. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. Leave it out for all platforms. |
| `compare` | query | boolean |  | true adds the equally long period just before as `previous`. |
| `timezone` | query | string |  | The IANA time zone used to split days, such as America/New_York. Defaults to UTC. The zone's offset at the end of the period is used for the whole period. |
| `by` | query | `platform`, `keyword`, `sentiment`, `intent`, `status`, `hour`, `person`, `language` | yes | How to group the rows. platform, keyword, sentiment (unclassified included), intent (a mention can have several), status (open, ignored, done), hour (weekday and hour in `timezone`), person (the author, without anonymous posts) or language (ISO 639-1, or "unknown" when there is none). |

Answers `200` with `window`, `by`, `data`: The rows, the one with the most matches first.

### `GET /v1/analytics/share-of-voice`: Get share of voice

Returns each keyword with matches in the period, its counts and its share of all brand and competitor matches. Topic keywords are counted but not part of the split. Pick the period with `range` (7d, 30d, 90d or 365d up to today) or with `from` and `to`. Days follow `timezone`, UTC by default. `keywordIds` and `platforms` narrow the data, and `compare=true` adds the equally long period just before. Dates are publish dates.

CLI: `rumoro analytics:share-of-voice`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `range` | query | `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `365d` |  | A preset period up to today, 30d by default. Ignored when you send from or to. |
| `from` | query | string |  | Start date in `timezone`, as YYYY-MM-DD. That day is included. |
| `to` | query | string |  | End date in `timezone`, as YYYY-MM-DD, included. Defaults to today. |
| `keywordIds` | query | string[] or null |  | Keeps these keyword ids only. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. Leave it out for all keywords. |
| `platforms` | query | list of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Keeps these platforms only. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. Leave it out for all platforms. |
| `compare` | query | boolean |  | true adds the equally long period just before as `previous`. |
| `timezone` | query | string |  | The IANA time zone used to split days, such as America/New_York. Defaults to UTC. The zone's offset at the end of the period is used for the whole period. |

Answers `200` with `window`, `data`: The keywords, the one with the most matches first.

### `GET /v1/analytics/reviews`: Get review stats

Returns stats on reviews your keywords collect from the App Store, Google Play, Trustpilot and Google Maps. You get the count, average stars, the star distribution, replies and open 1 and 2 star reviews, for the workspace and per review page. Each page has a series of average stars per `bucket`, and the report lists the tags of unhappy reviews. Two keywords matching one review count it once. Pick the period with `range` (7d, 30d, 90d or 365d up to today) or with `from` and `to`. Days follow `timezone`, UTC by default. `keywordIds` and `platforms` narrow the data, and `compare=true` adds the equally long period just before. Dates are publish dates.

CLI: `rumoro analytics:reviews`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `range` | query | `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `365d` |  | A preset period up to today, 30d by default. Ignored when you send from or to. |
| `from` | query | string |  | Start date in `timezone`, as YYYY-MM-DD. That day is included. |
| `to` | query | string |  | End date in `timezone`, as YYYY-MM-DD, included. Defaults to today. |
| `keywordIds` | query | string[] or null |  | Keeps these keyword ids only. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. Leave it out for all keywords. |
| `platforms` | query | list of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Keeps these platforms only. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. Leave it out for all platforms. |
| `compare` | query | boolean |  | true adds the equally long period just before as `previous`. |
| `timezone` | query | string |  | The IANA time zone used to split days, such as America/New_York. Defaults to UTC. The zone's offset at the end of the period is used for the whole period. |
| `bucket` | query | `day`, `week` |  | The step of each series, day or week. Days by default for periods up to 90 days. |

Answers `200` with `window`, `totals`, `tags`, `pages`, `previous`: The report, plus `previous` with compare=true.
